opening.argument: The presentation offers passive Bitcoin trading income through registration, wallet setup, and funding an account with a suggested minimum of $100 within seven days. It expressly describes the opportunity as “a passive income opportunity” and presents automated daily trading income with automatic compounding. The arrangement also ties referral and binary bonuses to recruiting members, maintaining trading-pool funds, and increasing trade amounts: qualification requires a minimum trading-pool amount and recruitment in both legs, while team growth permits increased trade amounts to qualify for earnings on more levels. Although results are not guaranteed, the presentation does not establish that any transfers, trading, bonus payments, or participant outcomes occurred.

citations.quote: Mirror Trading International provides you with a passive income opportunity.
Your daily trade income is automatically compounded.
you'll also need a minimum amount of $200 in the trading pool and you will need to have personally recruited one new member in your left and one in your right leg
As your team grows, you can increase your amount amount in trade so that you can qualify to earn on more levels
